posts.author: enelay
posts.text: The AGM lasted only 17 minutes so probably no attendance and Q&A. Maybe the H1 investor PPT will answer some of these questions. I did some further digging and couldn’t find any news on company / promoters / directors explaining the fall. It looks like Abundantia exiting their position fully into low liquidity + overall poor market condition + general downtrend in Envirotech. Abundantia sold 15 Oct when promoter was restricted from buying, so may be a timing issue vs communication issue.

posts.author: ha_the_meow
posts.text: If someone attended AGM could share updates, it would have been great. But I guess no one attended. Also NOIDA is a big industrial hub now, the permission must not be an issue for long. The delivery of the 20% dump is high, so someone big did dump. i don’t understand if promotor really wanted to buy the stock he would have good opportunity here, what they needed was communication. One might sell a stock for many reasons, but there is only one reason to buy ( coping on recent promotor buying ), I hope things get cleared fast fast.
